source_type_reasons: This smoke pack proves the Mathematics route can embed source material before question rendering.
The subject focus is graphs, diagrams and calculation evidence.
Educator approval remains mandatory before classroom use.

generation_constraints: Every source-referenced question must name a supplied SOURCE number.
Questions must be answerable from visible source material and subject knowledge.
Source readability, copyright/reuse status and CAPS fit must be reviewed by an educator.

sections.title: Method And Review
sections.instructions: Evaluate whether this generated assessment pack is ready for a real learner group.

questions.question: State TWO checks an educator must perform before releasing this assessment to learners.
memo: Check mark allocation and memo correctness.
Check copyright/reuse conditions for source material.

questions.question: Explain why official-paper source exemplars are stronger than generic generated visuals for this route.
memo: They reveal actual source types used in exams.
They still require adaptation and educator approval.

rubric.descriptor: Answers use visible evidence from supplied sources.
Answers use correct subject concepts and terminology.
Risks and approval checks are identified clearly.

teacher_review_checklist: Confirm each embedded source is readable after PDF export.

Confirm questions refer only to supplied or clearly stated evidence.
